_comment: Transform target ash you control into Miragai. Go again. Following the shipped invoke_nekria_red.json pattern from the same set. 'Target ash' is mandatory, not 'up to', so up_to is false: with no ash the transform simply cannot happen (CR 8.5.36d). GoAgain is a printed keyword that fires from the card DB keywords field; the shipped invoke_nekria_red also authors GO_AGAIN as an effect, which is redundant (CR 8.3.5c makes a second go again fail), but I follow the shipped pattern for consistency.
